properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1022020

Nearest City: Houston, TX
Location: HYDRAULIC POWER UNIT (HPU) ON THE SOUTHEAST SIDE OF BUILDING E 302 MCCARTY
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: HYDRAULIC OIL
Medium Affected: SOIL
Suspected Responsible Party: HYDRIL COMPANY
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 29.765848, -95.262103 (Approximated from ZIP)
Reported Spill Volume: 200 gallons
Report Description
A LEAKING HOSE AT THE HYDRAULIC POWER UNIT (HPU) ON THE SOUTHEAST SIDE OF BUILDING E CAUSED A SPILL OF APPROXIMATELY 200 GALLONS OF WHICH 100 GALLONS WAS CONTAINED IN THE SECONDARY CONTAINMENT FOR THE HPU AND 100 GALLONS WENT INTO THE SOIL. NO HYDRAULIC OIL ENTERED STORM DRAINS SO THERE WAS NO IMPACT ON WATER/STORMWATER. MAINTENANCE CREW BEGAN REPAIRS IMMEDIATELY TO STOP LEAK AND BEGAN CLEANING UP THE SPILL USING LIQUID VACUUM SYSTEMS, ABSORBENT MATERIALS, AND SOIL EXCAVATING EQUIPMENT. AN ENVIRONMENTAL EMERGENCY RESPONSE COMPANY WAS BROUGHT ON SITE TO FINISH UP THE SPILL CLEAN-UP. OILY SOIL AND SPILL CLEAN UP MATERIALS WERE PLACED INTO DRUMS FOR PROPER DISPOSAL. CLEAN FILL SOIL WAS BROUGHT ONSITE TO FILL FOR THE EXCAVATED SOIL.

Report Description///UPDATE TO REPORT #1349387/// THE UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWED: THE CALLER IS CHANGING THE TOTAL AMOUNT THAT DERAILED FROM 1 TO 11. THE CALLER STATES THAT THERE WERE 9 CARS WITH COAL THAT OVERTURNED AND 2 LOCOMOTIVES. THE AMOUNT OF COAL THAT RELEASE IS UNKNOWN, BUT THE AMOUNT OF DIESEL RELEASED WILL BE CHANGED FROM UNKNOWN TO 26 GALLONS. THE CALLER WILL BE UPDATING THE CAR NUMBERS AT A LATER DATE. THE ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION IS AS FOLLOWED: THE CALLER STATED THAT A FREIGHT TRAIN STRUCK A TRACTOR TRAILER TRUCK AT A GRADE CROSSING, WHICH RESULTED IN THE LEAD LOCOMOTIVE DERAILING AND RELEASING AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF DIESEL ONTO THE GROUND. BECAUSE OF THIS INCIDENT THE DRIVER OF THE TRUCK SUFFERED UNSPECIFIED INJURIES, HOWEVER IT IS UNKNOWN IF THEY WERE TRANSPORTED TO A NEARBY HOSPITAL. ALTHOUGH THE AMOUNT OF MATERIAL THAT RELEASED IS UNKNOWN, THE CALLER STATED IT CONTAINED UPWARDS OF (4000) GALLONS. THE CALLER STATED THAT THE SINGLE MAIN LINE TRACK WAS TAKEN OUT OF SERVICE IN ALL DIRECTIONS, AND THAT THAT IT WAS UNKNOWN IF THE ROAD ASSOCIATED WITH THE INCIDENT HAS BEEN CLOSED. BECAUSE OF THIS INCIDENT THE TRACK INVOLVED DID SUFFER DAMAGES OF AN UNKNOWN PRICE POINT.

Lat/Long: 35.728578, -77.933064 (Approximated from street_address)
Report Description
CALLER STATED THERE WAS A STRUCTURE FIRE AT A RESIDENCE AND THE FIRE DEPT WAS CONTACTED AND THEY RESPONDED. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT REQUESTED GAS PERSONNEL ONCE THEY ARRIVED ON SCENE. CALLER STATED THE FIRE DEPT SHUT THE GAS METER OFF. CALLER STATED AFTER THE GAS METER WAS SHUT OFF, THE FIRE DEPT. PERSONNEL SAW A FLASH FROM UNDERNEATH THE HOUSE WHICH IGNITED DUE TO THE HOUSE FIRE. CALLER STATED AN EXPLOSION OCCURRED AFTER THE FLASH. CALLER STATED THE BRAVO BRICK WALL WAS BLOWN OUT FIRST AND FELL ON THE GAS METER WHICH BROKE OFF THE GAS SERVICE RISER. CALLER STATED AFTER THIS, NATURAL GAS IS ESCAPING. AS THE GAS IS ESCAPING THE FIRE DEPT IS TRYING TO PUT THE FIRE OUT AND THE GAS PERSONNEL IS SHUTTING DOWN THE SERVICE KEY TO STOP THE FLOW OF GAS. CALLER STATED THIS WAS ORIGINALLY REPORTED YESTERDAY TO THE NORTH CAROLINA PIPELINE SAFETY SECTION WITHIN THE HOUR.
